notes.title: Our first major post-launch update arrives at June 6!

Performance Optimazation[/p][p]- Redesigned loading logic to eliminate lag spikes[/p][p]2. Subtitle Sync Fix[/p][p]- Fixed timing mismatches in all dialogue sequences[/p][p]3.
